labels: A staged retro school outfit pairs an elongated dark jacket with a long pleated skirt reaching near the ankles, shown head to shoe.; 연출된 복고 학원 복장이 긴 진한 재킷과 발목 가까이 오는 긴 주름치마를 조합하고 머리부터 신발까지 보인다.
definition: Complete optional school-life visual realization: A staged retro school outfit pairs an elongated dark jacket with a long pleated skirt reaching near the ankles, shown head to shoe.
